data.name: Triumphant Return
data.description: The phantom thief's tales are never truly forgotten. This makes it easier to establish his renown in a place he has established it before. In any settlement where the phantom thief previously gained renown, it takes only 3 days, rather than 1 week, to gain renown again.

raw_tokens.value: 2,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Phantom Thief Talent ~ Renown,Phantom Thief ~ Broad Education

The phantom thief's tales are never truly forgotten. This makes it easier to establish his renown in a place he has established it before. In any settlement where the phantom thief previously gained renown, it takes only 3 days, rather than 1 week, to gain renown again.
